source.label: Add source and evidence
source.requirement: Keep the source and evidence for important claims.

comparison.label: Add differences and comparison
comparison.requirement: Compare meaningful differences and keep the reasons and limitations.

action.label: Add actionable information
action.requirement: Keep practical details that help someone decide what to do.

general.name: General knowledge organization
general.description: Keep key ideas, context, and sources without a narrow use case.
general.requirement1: Organize the main ideas and background context.
general.requirement2: Keep sources and evidence with important claims.
general.impact: Illustration: keep key ideas and context easy to review later.
general.example:
Key ideas: paper notes make freehand diagrams easy; digital notes are easier to search.
Choice depends on how you like to organize.

study.name: Learning and research
study.description: Understand concepts, compare differences, and keep reasoning visible.
study.requirement1: Highlight core concepts, differences, reasons, and limitations.
study.requirement2: Keep the evidence and source behind each conclusion.
study.impact: Illustration: bring concepts and differences forward instead of keeping conclusions alone.
study.example:
Comparison: paper supports free visual expression; digital notes support retrieval.
The strengths differ, so one measure is not enough to choose.

work.name: Work and projects
work.description: Find decision reasons, constraints, and practical details quickly.
work.requirement1: Highlight workable options, decision reasons, and execution limits.
work.requirement2: Keep practical details and sources easy to find again.
work.impact: Illustration: make options and decision evidence easier to revisit at work.
work.example:
Decision reference: choose paper for freehand diagrams; choose digital notes when search matters.
Before adopting one, check how the team organizes its notes.

life.name: Life planning
life.description: Organize information around real situations and choices.
life.requirement1: Highlight practical uses, suitable situations, and choice conditions.
life.requirement2: Keep sources and limitations that still need checking.
life.impact: Illustration: bring situations and conditions forward to support everyday choices.
life.example:
How to choose: paper for frequent drawing and free notes; digital notes for finding things later.
Use the approach that fits your habits.

howItWorks.openEntry: How does data become searchable knowledge?
howItWorks.heading: From your source material to searchable knowledge
howItWorks.intro: Choose any stage to see what it does. This fixed story is independent of your Project and is not a processing status.
howItWorks.fixedExampleLabel: Fixed hypothetical example · the district is stated in the note, not inferred from the restaurant name.

raw.name: Source material
raw.title: Start with the material you provide
raw.description: Notes and other sources are the starting point for a knowledge base.
raw.boundary: Profile does not rewrite the source material. Adding material does not mean it has already been organized or can be searched.

pipeline.name: Organize
pipeline.title: Run the pipeline to organize the source
pipeline.description: The pipeline turns source material into readable knowledge and information that can support search.
pipeline.boundary: Saving a new preference does not automatically rewrite existing articles. This example does not run a pipeline.

knowledge.name: Knowledge and tags
knowledge.title: One output for people, another for recognition
knowledge.description: Readable concepts explain the source; tags record details that may help search.
knowledge.boundary: Writing and tagging may finish at different times. “Not mentioned” does not mean “does not meet the condition.”

query.name: Search and ask
query.title: Ask about a place and compare relevant details
query.description: A question can state the needed area first, then express optional preferences.
query.boundary: This is a fixed example, not a live search result or a claim about every current query runtime.

howItWorks.sourceExample: Example note: Qingting Restaurant serves home-style food in Taipei City’s Da’an District. A paid parking lot is about a three-minute walk away. The restaurant has child seats, but its walkway is narrow. The note does not say whether a stroller can pass comfortably.
howItWorks.pipelineFocusHeading: What the pipeline may emphasize · fixed illustration
howItWorks.pipelineFocusGeneral: In this general example, organization keeps the stated place and source facts without personal preference cues.
howItWorks.pipelineFocusWithPreferences: With {preferences}, this illustration gives more attention to related source details while keeping the stated district. Stroller access remains unknown.
howItWorks.conceptExampleGeneral: Qingting Restaurant serves home-style food in Taipei City’s Da’an District. The note mentions a nearby paid parking lot about a three-minute walk away, child seats, and a narrow walkway. Stroller access is not stated.
howItWorks.conceptExampleParking: Qingting Restaurant serves home-style food in Taipei City’s Da’an District. Since parking matters in this example, the concept highlights the nearby paid lot about a three-minute walk away. Stroller access is not stated.
howItWorks.conceptExampleChildren: Qingting Restaurant serves home-style food in Taipei City’s Da’an District. Since suitability for children matters in this example, the concept highlights the child seats and narrow walkway. Stroller access is not stated.
howItWorks.conceptExampleParkingAndChildren: Qingting Restaurant serves home-style food in Taipei City’s Da’an District. Since parking and suitability for children matter in this example, the concept highlights the nearby paid lot, child seats, and narrow walkway. Stroller access is not stated.
howItWorks.tagExampleGeneral: Place: Taipei City, Da’an District. Type: restaurant. The note includes parking, child-seat, and walkway details; stroller access is not stated.
howItWorks.tagExampleWithPreferences: Place: Taipei City, Da’an District. Compare details related to {preferences}: the note says paid parking is about a three-minute walk away, child seats are available, and the walkway is narrow. Stroller access remains unknown because it is not mentioned.
howItWorks.unknownRemainsUnknown: Missing information stays unknown; it is not treated as a negative fact.
howItWorks.requiredScopeQuery: Find restaurants in Taipei City’s Da’an District.
howItWorks.preferenceComparison: Consider {preferences} when comparing relevant details. These preferences do not remove or replace the stated district.
howItWorks.noPreferenceComparison: With general settings, this example asks about restaurants in the district without adding personal preferences.
howItWorks.queryLimits: The district is needed for this example question. This illustration uses no GPS or distance calculation and does not promise a general hard geographic filter. It does not claim that every current query runtime filters location first.
howItWorks.profileExampleHeading: How Profile can affect later steps
howItWorks.profileExampleDescription: Profile may guide later organization or express search preferences. This example shows intended influence only; it is not an active setting.
howItWorks.storyOnlyNotice: These choices update only the fixed illustration. They do not change your Project draft, saved Profile, existing articles, or current search.
howItWorks.showProfileExample: See how Profile affects this step

CLILane.title: Connect your wiki with the CLI
CLILane.intro: Download the CLI, approve sign-in in the Web app, connect your existing wiki folder, then push files from raw/.
CLILane.agentNote: A person or agent with local command-execution ability can follow these steps; this page does not run commands on your computer.
CLILane.downloadDescription: Choose a platform manually. Downloads appear only after a matching release archive is available.
CLILane.versionCommand: After downloading and extracting, open a terminal in the extracted folder and run:
CLILane.loginDescription: The command uses this app’s Auth address. It prints a one-time URL and code; it does not approve itself.
CLILane.loginApproval: Open the printed URL and approve the CLI in the Web app.
CLILane.loginCode: If no browser opens, copy the URL and code printed by the CLI.
CLILane.loginComplete: Return to the terminal and wait for the sign-in complete message.
CLILane.folderDescription: Use the root of your existing wiki folder. The same init command works for a new or already connected raw folder.
CLILane.rootLabel: Absolute path to your wiki root
CLILane.rootHint: Use an absolute path. The example contains a replaceable user-name placeholder; it does not read your computer or create a folder. A quoted ~ is literal.
CLILane.rawScope: The CLI syncs files inside raw/. Do not add raw/ to this root path.
CLILane.sameInit: Copy the command, then run it in the directory containing the CLI. It prepares or confirms the binding; it does not upload files.
CLILane.recoveryGuidance: Recover only missing or unfinished metadata after verifying this is the same vault. Reauthorize only a revoked binding when the local host, project, wiki, and binding identity match; if anything differs, stop and verify instead.
CLILane.enterRoot: Enter a wiki root path to prepare this command.
CLILane.obsidianTitle: If your vault is in Obsidian
CLILane.obsidianDescription: On macOS, in Finder press Command+Shift+G and enter ~/Library/Mobile Documents/iCloud~md~obsidian/Documents/, then select your Vault root folder. If that path is unavailable, reveal the existing vault in Finder; on other platforms use Show in file manager. Copy its absolute folder path; do not import or move the whole vault.
CLILane.syncDescription: Copy source material into raw/ first. Keep the original if you want; when it changes, update the copy in raw/ before pushing.
CLILane.syncOption: Also download files that exist only in the cloud (--sync)
CLILane.syncConflict: Changed local raw files update their matching cloud files. A concurrent change or source change stops with a non-zero result; review it and rerun.
CLILane.syncNoDelete: Deletes are not sent. --sync only fills cloud-only paths and does not overwrite local files.
CLILane.syncNoCompile: Push does not compile or run generation.
CLILane.syncReady: After push succeeds, return to the Web app and start generation before searching the new content.
CLILane.copyFailed: Could not copy the command. Select and copy it manually.
